title: Legacy emhawkes FRPP examples
text: following example defines point process custom residual distribution. details, see Self mutually exciting point process embedding flexible residuals intensity discretely Markovian dynamics. residual density trapezoidal section exponential tail. dresidual, presidual, qresidual functions receive distribution parameters param vector. ordinary Hawkes model special case exponential residual distribution rate 1. Use set_residual wrap distribution functions log-density tail-probability support.  Use logLik evaluate observed inter-arrival times hspec1_d. Setting infer = TRUE also returns intensity residual processes infer_res_dh1.
code: mu1_d <- 0.5; alpha1_d <- 1; beta1_d <- 1.2; a <- 0.7; ell <- 1.6 hspec1_d <- set_residual(   new("hspec", mu = mu1_d, alpha = alpha1_d, beta = beta1_d),   param = c(a = a, ell = ell),   dresidual = dtzexp, presidual = ptzexp,   qresidual = qtzexp, rresidual = rtzexp ) dh1_real <- hsim(hspec1_d, size = 3000) #> Initial intensity components: auto -> zero (no supported unconditional mean formula for this model). Supplying lambda_component0 explicitly is recommended for this model. hist(   dh1_real$inter_arrival[dh1_real$inter_arrival < 3],   breaks = 50,   main = "Histogram of Inter-Arrival Times",   xlab = "Inter-Arrival Time",   ylab = "Frequency" ) # Infer the residual process using the log-likelihood method # 'infer_res_dh1' contains the inferred process data based on the inter-arrival times infer_res_dh1 <- logLik(hspec1_d, inter_arrival = dh1_real$inter_arrival, infer = TRUE)  # Plot a histogram of the inferred residual process hist(   infer_res_dh1$res_process1,   breaks = 100,   probability = TRUE,   main = "Histogram of Inferred Residual Process",   xlab = "Residual Value",   ylab = "Density" )  x <- seq(0, 8, 0.1)  lines(   x,   dtzexp(x, a = a, ell = ell),   col = 'red',   lwd = 2 )  # Add legend for clarity legend("topright", legend = "Theoretical PDF", col = "red", lwd = 2)

text: approach extends multiple dimensions, using parameter matrices multivariate Hawkes model. following histogram shows inter-arrival times model tzexp residuals.  Use logLik infer = TRUE recover intensity residual processes. correctly specified model, inferred residuals follow specified residual distribution.  transformed residuals eres_process1 follow exponential distribution rate 1 correctly specified model.  Use hfit maximum likelihood estimation. distribution requires 0 < <= 3, ell > 0, nonnegative density. last condition nonlinear, custom objective checks candidate dtzexp returns -Inf distribution invalid. Hawkes curvature stabilization change custom FRPP objective. moving transition point tzexp can make numerical Hessians step dependent. successful optimizer return code validate reported Wald standard errors. See fit diagnostic report one-sided derivative profile checks. constraints keep six parameters nonnegative enforce <= 3, upper limit trapezoid-exponential distribution. parameter order mu1, alpha1.1, alpha1.2, beta1.1, , ell. Reconstruction also updates residual density, distribution, quantile, generator functions shared estimates ell. custom objective optimization constraints remain part fitting step; logLik() evaluates restored model’s residual-distribution likelihood.
code: mu2_d <- matrix(c(0.3), nrow = 2) alpha2_d <- matrix(c(0.5, 0.8, 0.8, 0.5), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE) beta2_d <- matrix(c(1.5, 1.5, 1.5, 1.5), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE) a <- 0.7; ell <- 1.6  hspec2_du <- set_residual(   new("hspec", mu = mu2_d, alpha = alpha2_d, beta = beta2_d),   param = c(a = a, ell = ell),   dresidual = dtzexp, presidual = ptzexp,   qresidual = qtzexp, rresidual = rtzexp ) print(hspec2_du) #> An object of class "hspec" of 2-dimensional Hawkes process #>  #> Slot mu:  #>      [,1] #> [1,]  0.3 #> [2,]  0.3 #>  #> Slot alpha:  #>      [,1] [,2] #> [1,]  0.5  0.8 #> [2,]  0.8  0.5 #>  #> Slot beta:  #>      [,1] [,2] #> [1,]  1.5  1.5 #> [2,]  1.5  1.5 #>  #> Slot rresidual:  #> function (size, param = c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6))  #> { #>     do.call(rresidual, c(list(size), distribution_parameters(rresidual,  #>         param))) #> } #> <environment: 0x56459bcee4c0> #>  #> Slot dresidual:  #> function (x, param = c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6), log = FALSE)  #> { #>     residual_density(dresidual, x, log = log, params = distribution_parameters(dresidual,  #>         param)) #> } #> <environment: 0x56459bcee4c0> #>  #> Slot presidual:  #> function (q, param = c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6), lower.tail = TRUE,  #>     log.p = FALSE)  #> { #>     residual_cdf(presidual, q, lower.tail = lower.tail, log.p = log.p,  #>         params = distribution_parameters(presidual, param)) #> } #> <environment: 0x56459bcee4c0> #>  #> Slot qresidual:  #> function (p, param = c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6), lower.tail = TRUE,  #>     log.p = FALSE)  #> { #>     residual_quantile(qresidual, p, lower.tail = lower.tail,  #>         log.p = log.p, params = distribution_parameters(qresidual,  #>             param)) #> } #> <environment: 0x56459bcee4c0> set.seed(1107) duh2_real <- hsim(hspec2_du, size = 10000) #> Initial intensity components: auto -> zero (no supported unconditional mean formula for this model). Supplying lambda_component0 explicitly is recommended for this model. # Plot a histogram of the inter-arrival times less than 5 hist(   duh2_real$inter_arrival[duh2_real$inter_arrival < 5],   breaks = 50,   main = "Histogram of Inter-Arrival Times",   xlab = "Inter-Arrival Time",   ylab = "Frequency" ) infer_res_dh2 <- logLik(hspec2_du,                         inter_arrival = duh2_real$inter_arrival,                         type = duh2_real$type, infer = TRUE) # Plot a histogram of the inferred residual process hist(   infer_res_dh2$res_process2,   breaks = 50,   probability = TRUE,   main = "Histogram of Inferred Residual Process",   xlab = "Residual Value",   ylab = "Density" )  # Generate a sequence of x values for plotting the theoretical distribution x <- seq(0, 8, 0.1)  # Add a line to the histogram representing the theoretical density function lines(   x,   dtzexp(x, a = a, ell = ell),   col = 'red',   lwd = 2 )  # Add legend for clarity legend("topright", legend = "Theoretical PDF", col = "red", lwd = 2) hist(   infer_res_dh2$eres_process1,   breaks = 50,   probability = TRUE,   main = "Histogram of Inferred eResidual Process",   xlab = "Residual Value",   ylab = "Density" )  # Generate a sequence of x values for plotting the theoretical distribution x <- seq(0, 8, 0.1)  # Add a line to the histogram representing the theoretical density function lines(   x,   dexp(x),   col = 'red',   lwd = 2 )  # Add legend for clarity legend("topright", legend = "Theoretical PDF", col = "red", lwd = 2) residual_loglik <- function(object, inter_arrival, type, param) {   valid <- tryCatch({     dtzexp(1, a = param["a"], ell = param["ell"])     TRUE   }, error = function(e) FALSE)   if (!valid) return(-Inf)   suppressMessages(logLik(object, inter_arrival = inter_arrival, type = type)) } constraints <- list(   ineqA = rbind(diag(6), c(0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0)),   ineqB = c(rep(0, 6), 3) ) mle_dh <- hfit(hspec2_du,                inter_arrival = duh2_real$inter_arrival,                type = duh2_real$type,                mylogLik = residual_loglik,                constraints = constraints) summary(mle_dh) estimated_dh <- fitted_hspec(mle_dh) initial_dh <- fit_initial_state(mle_dh) formals(estimated_dh@rresidual)$param inferred_dh <- do.call(logLik, c(list(object = estimated_dh,   inter_arrival = duh2_real$inter_arrival, type = duh2_real$type, infer = TRUE), initial_dh)) c(fitted = as.numeric(logLik(mle_dh)), restored = inferred_dh$loglikelihood)

title: Legacy emhawkes FRPP examples
text: following example uses uniform residual distribution [0,2][0, 2]. Plot histogram inferred residuals:
code: #set.seed(117) mu2_d <- matrix(c(0.5), nrow = 2) alpha2_d <- matrix(c(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE) beta2_d <- matrix(c(1.2, 1.2, 1.2, 1.2), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)  hspec2_du <- new("hspec", mu=mu2_d, alpha=alpha2_d, beta=beta2_d,                  rresidual = function(size) runif(n=size, 0, 2),                  dresidual = function(x, param = numeric(0), log = FALSE)                    dunif(x, 0, 2, log = log),                  presidual = function(q, param = numeric(0), lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)                    punif(q, 0, 2, lower.tail = lower.tail, log.p = log.p),                  qresidual = function(p, param = numeric(0), lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)                    qunif(p, 0, 2, lower.tail = lower.tail, log.p = log.p))  duh2_real <- hsim(hspec2_du, size = 5000) infer_res_duh2 <- logLik(hspec2_du,                          inter_arrival = duh2_real$inter_arrival,                          type = duh2_real$type, infer = TRUE)  hist(   infer_res_duh2$res_process1,   breaks = 50,   probability = TRUE,   main = "Histogram of Inferred Residual Process",   xlab = "Residual Value",   ylab = "Density" )

title: Fitting and inference

Fix excitation decay parameters example. three events one unit time; baseline MLE 3. tighter optimizer tolerance makes example easier compare analytic answer; validate inference complicated models.
code: model <- fspec(   methods::new("hspec", mu = 1, alpha = 0, beta = 1),   residual_law(c(rate = 1), stats::dexp, stats::pexp,     stats::qexp, stats::rexp)) dt <- c(0, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5) fit <- ffit(model, dt, optimizer = "stats", lambda_component0 = 0,   fixed = c(FALSE, TRUE, TRUE), control = list(reltol = 1e-12)) coef(fit) #>    mu1 alpha1  beta1  #>      3      0      1

Controls differ: stats uses control$maxit, maxLik uses control$iterlim. default, equal starting values within numeric matrix share parameter. Use reduced = FALSE separate entries. Function parameters name remain shared. Inspect coef(fit) see resulting names order specifying fixed parameters constraints. constraint constraints alternative spellings; supply one. Linear inequalities use list(ineqA = , ineqB = B) Aθ+B≥0A\theta + B \geq 0. Columns follow full optimization parameter order, including fixed coordinates. stats constrained optimizer requires interior start support equality constraints. valid = function(param) callback can reject invalid parameter proposals returning FALSE. errors propagate; deterministic.

code: tz_law <- residual_law(c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6),   density = emhawkes::dtzexp, cdf = emhawkes::ptzexp,   quantile = emhawkes::qtzexp, rng = emhawkes::rtzexp, name = "tzexp") model_1d <- fspec(   methods::new("hspec", mu = 0.5, alpha = 1, beta = 1.2), tz_law) set.seed(1107) path_1d <- fsim(model_1d, size = 3000, lambda_component0 = 0) seed_1d <- .Random.seed inferred_1d <- logLik(model_1d, path_1d$inter_arrival,   lambda_component0 = 0, infer = TRUE) state_1d <- if (has_kernel_api) logLik(model_1d, path_1d$inter_arrival,   lambda_component0 = 0, infer = TRUE, backend = "state") else NULL c(bridge = inferred_1d$loglikelihood,   state = if (has_kernel_api) state_1d$loglikelihood else NA_real_) #>   bridge    state  #> 1114.393 1114.393 hist(inferred_1d$res_process1, breaks = 100, probability = TRUE,   main = "One-dimensional FRPP residuals", xlab = "Residual") curve(emhawkes::dtzexp(x, a = 0.7, ell = 1.6), add = TRUE, col = "red")

what: Compare the original and migrated examples
title: FRPP examples migrated from emhawkes
text: reference objects use original representation. Compare every simulation field final RNG state exactly. bridge must return inference result. Independent state calculations use fixed numerical comparison tolerance 1e-10; absolute differences also reported.
code: reference_1d <- emhawkes::set_residual(   methods::new("hspec", mu = 0.5, alpha = 1, beta = 1.2),   param = c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6), dresidual = emhawkes::dtzexp,   presidual = emhawkes::ptzexp, qresidual = emhawkes::qtzexp,   rresidual = emhawkes::rtzexp) reference_2d <- emhawkes::set_residual(   methods::new("hspec", mu = c(0.3, 0.3),     alpha = matrix(c(0.5, 0.8, 0.8, 0.5), 2, byrow = TRUE),     beta = matrix(1.5, 2, 2)),   param = c(a = 0.7, ell = 1.6), dresidual = emhawkes::dtzexp,   presidual = emhawkes::ptzexp, qresidual = emhawkes::qtzexp,   rresidual = emhawkes::rtzexp) reference_uniform <- methods::new("hspec", mu = c(0.5, 0.5),   alpha = matrix(0.3, 2, 2), beta = matrix(1.2, 2, 2),   rresidual = function(size) runif(n = size, 0, 2),   dresidual = function(x, param = numeric(0), log = FALSE) dunif(x, 0, 2, log = log),   presidual = function(q, param = numeric(0), lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)     punif(q, 0, 2, lower.tail = lower.tail, log.p = log.p),   qresidual = function(p, param = numeric(0), lower.tail = TRUE, log.p = FALSE)     qunif(p, 0, 2, lower.tail = lower.tail, log.p = log.p)) compare_example <- function(reference, path, seed_after, bridge, state) {   set.seed(1107)   old <- emhawkes::hsim(reference, size = length(path$type), lambda_component0 = 0)   fields <- setdiff(names(old), "hspec")   stopifnot(identical(unclass(path)[fields], unclass(old)[fields]),     identical(.Random.seed, seed_after))   expected <- emhawkes::logLik(reference, old$inter_arrival, old$type,     mark = old$mark, lambda_component0 = 0, infer = TRUE)   stopifnot(identical(bridge, expected))   shared <- names(expected)   if (!is.null(state)) stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(state[shared], expected, tolerance = 1e-10)))   data.frame(rows = length(path$type), simulation_exact = TRUE, rng_exact = TRUE,     bridge_exact = TRUE,     state_loglik_difference = if (is.null(state)) NA_real_ else state$loglikelihood - expected$loglikelihood,     maximum_state_output_difference = if (is.null(state)) NA_real_ else max(vapply(shared, function(nm)       if (length(expected[[nm]])) max(abs(state[[nm]] - expected[[nm]])) else 0,       numeric(1)))) } comparison <- rbind(   tzexp_1d = compare_example(reference_1d, path_1d, seed_1d, inferred_1d, state_1d),   tzexp_2d = compare_example(reference_2d, path_2d, seed_2d, inferred_2d, state_2d),   uniform_2d = compare_example(reference_uniform, path_uniform, seed_uniform,     inferred_uniform, state_uniform)) comparison #>             rows simulation_exact rng_exact bridge_exact #> tzexp_1d    3000             TRUE      TRUE         TRUE #> tzexp_2d   10000             TRUE      TRUE         TRUE #> uniform_2d  5000             TRUE      TRUE         TRUE #>            state_loglik_difference maximum_state_output_difference #> tzexp_1d             -7.048584e-12                    7.048584e-12 #> tzexp_2d              5.456968e-12                    5.456968e-12 #> uniform_2d            4.947651e-10                    4.947651e-10
